title: Slaapfeestjes fenomeen
description:
A sleepover as an act of collective prayer, where its participants drift towards timeless-ness. 
We find these friends among each other, right on the edge of sleep and still being awake, asking us to ponder on the extreme intimacy of this small, but inevitable moment part of all shared nights together.

title: Rinkel twinkel
description: Focusing on the moment right before opening up, the viewer is placed in the position of getting to decide whether to let this visitor into their private space. Keeping the exterior as well as the interior space ambiguous, attention is drawn to the chain separating the two. An object that both shields and reflects the room behind it, hanging perfectly in the in-between, only allowing for glimpses to be seen.
